source.description:
## PROBLEM
~/.claude/hooks/xtmux/auto-monitor-drain-stop.mjs (a Stop hook) shells out to `xtmux obligations list` to gate the Stop cycle, but the Claude Code Stop hook subprocess does NOT inherit $TMUX / $TMUX_PANE from the parent Claude session. Result: every Stop fires the error XTMUX_NOT_IN_TMUX and the guard falls back to allowing the next Stop through. Benign, but noisy and defeats the drain-check intent.

## SUCCESS
Hook either:
(a) wraps the xtmux call to auto-discover the parent tmux socket + session/pane and export TMUX/TMUX_PANE, or
(b) checks env presence first and skips silently (no error output) when not in tmux, or
(c) uses a socket-based fallback that doesn't require TMUX env at all.

Preferable: (a), because auto-discovery preserves the drain-gate semantic.

## SCOPE
- ~/.claude/hooks/xtmux/auto-monitor-drain-stop.mjs (add env discovery / graceful skip)

## NON_GOALS
- Redesigning the auto-monitor state model.

## CONSTRAINTS
- Must remain a Stop hook (no interactive prompts, no long blocking calls).

## VALIDATION
- Fresh Claude Code session (spawned outside tmux) does not see the XTMUX_NOT_IN_TMUX error on Stop.
- Existing tmux-in-tmux sessions still get the drain-gate to run correctly.

## OUTPUT
PR link + one-line diff on the hook script.
